{%- comment -%}
  Fixture css-variables. :root tokens (--card-gap also sits on :root in the
  fixture asset CSS: it is in the default allow-list), a name built by Liquid,
  a scheme block (not :root) and a :root block inside @media.
  A commented-out declaration must be ignored: :root { --fixture-gap: 1px; }
{%- endcomment -%}
{% style %}
  @font-face {
    font-family: 'Fixture';
    src: url('{{ 'fixture.woff2' | asset_url }}') format('woff2');
  }

  :root {
    --font-heading: 'Fixture', sans-serif;
    --color-accent: {% if settings.color_accent != blank %}{{ settings.color_accent }}{% else %}#623827{% endif %};
    --card-gap: {{ settings.card_gap | default: 6 }}px;
    /* --fixture-gap: 2px; (a CSS comment: not a declaration) */
    --t-title-size: calc(1.5rem * var(--heading-scale, 1));
    --t-title-size-m: calc(1.3rem * var(--heading-scale, 1));
    {%- for style in styles %}
    --t-{{ style }}-lh: 1.3;
    {%- endfor %}
  }

  [data-color-scheme="accent"] {
    --color-heading: #F9F6F2;
    --color-link-hover: #F9F6F2;
  }

  @media (max-width: 749px) {
    :root {
      --page-margin: {{ settings.page_margin_mobile | default: 10 }}px;
    }
  }
{% endstyle %}
